fightSong.title: Raise the Flag
fightSong.lyrics: Hoist the colors, fire the gun / Tampa pirates, here we come / Plunder points and take the gold / Pirate football, brave and bold!

stadium.name: The Brig
stadium.tradition: The Cannon — a real pirate ship cannon fires after every score. It once set a nacho stand on fire. We kept it.

fanCulture.description: They wear eye patches to day games. After turnovers they yell 'WALK THE PLANK!' It's Gasparilla every Sunday.
fanCulture.tailgate: On boats, in the parking lot, everywhere.

rivalries.name: The Sunshine State
rivalries.narrative: East coast vs west coast Florida. Both weird.

cityFlavor: Pirates, beaches, and lightning. We do storms right.
